purpose: Machine-readable contract for ERL Physical Economics observations, transitions, state vectors, and sub-index inputs.
core_rule: No economic unit is assumed state-equivalent across time; continuity requires evidence across economically relevant attributes.

erl_transition_mapping.S_pre: prior economic-unit, producer, household, or population state
erl_transition_mapping.S_post: subsequent economic-unit, producer, household, or population state
erl_transition_mapping.C: evidenced continuity relation for the compared unit or system
erl_transition_mapping.E: price, quantity, quality, income, cost, margin, burden, need, tax/fee and administrative evidence
erl_transition_mapping.U: typed unknowns including missing quantity, margin, need, or pass-through

producer_cost_margin_transmission.inference_policy: Residual or inferred margins are allowed only when direct financial inputs are unavailable and must be explicitly lower-confidence.

adjacent_index_policy.income: Use nominal income/resources as primary. CPI-deflated real earnings are comparator evidence, not the sole purchasing-power denominator.
adjacent_index_policy.debt_service: Federal Reserve DSR may be imported after coverage validation; supplement distribution and non-debt compulsory obligations.
adjacent_index_policy.price_indexes: CPI/PPI are evidence surfaces, not full economic-condition state representations.

anti_failure_rules: Do not infer lower need from lower acquisition.
Do not infer producer profiteering from consumer price change without direct margin evidence.
Do not infer producer distress from falling margin without controlling for output, mix, accounting scope, and one-time items.
Do not import CPI-deflated real income as independent validation of a CPI-alternative purchasing-power leg.
Do not aggregate away distribution before reporting population burden surfaces.
Do not double count taxes, fees, margins, subsidies, transfers, or delivery charges as they propagate through the value-flow graph.
Do not treat same sticker price as continuity when physical quantity, quality, coverage, service level, or mandatory fees changed.
Do not publish a scalar composite without the underlying state vector and provenance.
